title: Hydropower Vision: A New Chapter for America’s 1st Renewable Electricity Source
lineage: Passages inspected; retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: Section 2.7.1, History and Status of Pumped Storage Hydropower
passages.note: The report describes an 1882 Zurich pump, turbine and small reservoir as a hydro-mechanical storage system operating nearly a decade; this does not establish grid electricity storage there.
